styles.name: Holo Iridescent
styles.coreTrick: A pearl ground carries one large tilted plane whose hue drifts in bands (repeating radial fringes plus a conic sweep in a fixed five-colour order), while UI stays solid hairline cards with the spectrum confined to one featured edge, the primary's rim and selected states.
styles.colourRecipe: The client primary stays a solid action colour with a thin spectral rim; the spectrum is fixed pastel and never a brand role; the accent only seeds the one gradient headline word (shaded to 3.2:1); a muted client colour is pulled toward ink to 4.7:1; dark canvases are forced to near black (<=8% lightness).

remainder.what: Foil plane composition: layer stacking, gradient origins (28% 118%, 72% 30%), 16deg/-8deg perspective tilt, 100cqw sizing, debossed initial position and the narrow-board and deck-cover variants, all hand-tuned in cqw units
remainder.whyCode: A generator could emit the gradients, but the placement values are visual judgements per board size, not parameters that transfer

remainder.what: Bubble geometry: wedge rotation offsets, canvas-coloured black spot only in light mode, per-board unique filter ids
remainder.whyCode: Procedural SVG assembled in art() with mode-conditional branches

remainder.what: App kit wiring: which of ~70 kit components receive foil wash, spectral rim, hairline panel or chrome (about 70 lines of selectors scoped to both holo-iridescent and --classic)
remainder.whyCode: Per-component decisions; only generable from a kit-component map plus rules like 'selected state gets foil wash'

remainder.what: Row avatars as spectral dots shifted with hue-rotate
remainder.whyCode: One-off ornament replacing the avatar

styles.notes: Kit lines 350-544 were not read in full; they repeat the foil-wash / hairline-panel / chrome pattern (kit cards, tables, tabs) so the coverage estimate assumes the same split as lines 281-349. exportSafe on spectral-hairline-edge is unverified.

styles.name: Industrial Device
styles.coreTrick: The product is the page: a life-size hardware illustration of keys, encoders and an OLED bleeds off the board edge with every legend printed on it, and the UI reuses the hardware parts (keys with a 2px underside that compresses, recessed slots, LED-bar meters).
styles.colourRecipe: The client primary appears on exactly four things: the one main key and selected key, the knob pointer, the fourth encoder cap, and the OLED pixels (lifted to 7:1 on black); every other colour on the device is a fixed code (blue, green, white, graphite), and the canvas is pulled 42% toward aluminium grey (55% toward graphite in dark).

remainder.what: Device layout: a 100x64 unit coordinate board placing grille, OLED, encoders, knob, 4x4 pads, function keys, keybed and model line, plus transport icon SVGs
remainder.whyCode: A composed illustration; positions and part inventory are bespoke and not reducible to a few params

remainder.what: OLED word fitting (first word only, font scale 9/len) and the key legend table with graphite function column logic
remainder.whyCode: Text-measurement and per-key conditional classes

remainder.what: Deck material slide reuses the same drawing at 1.5x zoom cropped on the pads and keybed
remainder.whyCode: Bespoke crop of the bespoke art

remainder.what: About 20 editable device legend strings (copy keys)
remainder.whyCode: Content, not look; a framework would need a legend-list field

styles.notes: css lines 251-542 (kit and built-screen rules) were only skimmed via section markers; they reuse key-underside-press, recessed-field and hairline-panel.

styles.name: Isogrid
styles.coreTrick: A single doubling ladder (spacing 4/8/16/32/64/128, type 12/24/48/96) drives every size, containers are 1px square outlines never fills, tall buttons anchor label top-left and arrow bottom-right, and selection is a 4px primary bar on the top edge.
styles.colourRecipe: The canvas is white or near-black with a trace of the primary hue; the primary is searched along lightness (both directions) until it holds 4.6:1 on the canvas and carries a 4.6:1 label, then used for the main button, selection bar, focus ring and the filled faces of the isometric drawing; hairlines are ink pulled toward the canvas until 3.2:1.

remainder.what: Isometric extrusion renderer: 5x7 glyph lookup with accent folding, per-cell seeded depth, back-to-front sort, hidden-face culling, ladder cubes
remainder.whyCode: Geometry and seeded randomness; the svg-generator move names it but the algorithm itself is code

remainder.what: Font weight resolution: light 300 only for Plex Sans (declared in mainframe.css), nearest published weight otherwise
remainder.whyCode: Depends on the font registry and on another style's @font-face

remainder.what: Board-only art lattice plus deck material specimen grid (2x2 cells of scale, buttons, field, tabs)
remainder.whyCode: Bespoke specimen markup

styles.notes: Most of the look is rule-driven so coverage is high. css lines 231-616 (built screens and kit) were not read in full; kit sizing is via --k-btn/--k-cardpad/--k-gap tokens (line 217) which is a tokens-only move.

styles.name: Japanese Minimal
styles.coreTrick: Ma as material: a warm off-white ground, a strict column grid and 1px hairline rules with small regular-weight type, one plain 2px-corner primary action, and a single fixed vermilion dot per view; the only ornament is a measured hairline grid with ticks.
styles.colourRecipe: The client primary is only the one plain filled action, the selected underline, focus ring and progress fill; the accent is ignored and replaced by a fixed flag-red dot (#BC002D, lifted in lightness only if under 3:1 on a dark canvas); ink is mixed 70% toward near-black and the canvas is mixed 80% toward warm off-white, so a muted client primary changes nothing but the action.

remainder.what: Headline hook: balances lines with a character budget and wraps only the last word as the emphasis span
remainder.whyCode: Per-word text layout logic (line budget, trailing punctuation) a rule file cannot express

remainder.what: Hero art and deck specimen SVGs: coordinates, tick loops, rotated label, three captioned samples
remainder.whyCode: Procedural SVG with fixed layout; only partly parameterised by hairline-grid-field

remainder.what: Deck rules: do/dont marks drawn as a square and a rotated rule, deck cell and rule resets
remainder.whyCode: Slide-specific overrides

remainder.what: Accent swatch shows the dot's own hex via a CSS custom string and pseudo-element
remainder.whyCode: Special-case swatch that bypasses the client accent

remainder.what: Loads the Shippori Mincho font family on demand from tokens()
remainder.whyCode: Side effect in a token hook

styles.notes: css lines 229-644 (kit block D14 from 436, built screens) not read in full; they follow the same hairline/2px-corner/one-dot rules.

styles.name: Liquid Glass
styles.coreTrick: Clear see-through glass (7-16% white, 4px blur with saturate and brightness lift, bright two-sided rim, soft contact shadow) floats over a hard-edged brand-colour scene, with an SVG displacement-filter lens that bends the scene only at its rim; never frosted.
styles.colourRecipe: The client primary becomes the main light plane of the scene and a tinted-glass action at partial alpha (alpha raised until the label holds 4.5:1); accent and secondary become the other planes of the scene; the dark scene base is the ink 80% toward black (canvas 50% toward black in dark); a muted client colour is pulled toward ink until 4.5:1 on the glass fill.

remainder.what: Lens placement: width from a per-letter glyph-advance table, height from the art aspect ratio, and a duplicated scene repositioned so it registers 1:1 inside each lens
remainder.whyCode: Geometry computed from letter metrics and container ratios; the filter is a move, the registration is code

remainder.what: Unique per-board filter ids and feImage normal-map data URIs built in a chain
remainder.whyCode: Runtime-generated SVG filter graph

remainder.what: Tab icons and the hero art markup (scene, two lenses for wide and narrow, tabs, slider)
remainder.whyCode: Bespoke illustration; narrow vs wide lens switch at css 146-157

remainder.what: Narrow-board re-stacking: scene stops 30/62/70, tab bar to the top, slider to the bottom, copy below on canvas with highlight band
remainder.whyCode: Responsive recomposition of the hero

remainder.what: Product backdrop (soft brand field behind glass sidebar/header) and gel hover scale 1.03 / 0.97 are described in rules; only the 0.98 press was verified in css
